newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aristocrat unsure when trading to resume.
newsitem.headline: Aristocrat unsure when trading to resume.

text.p: Gaming machine operator Aristocrat Leisure Ltd said on Friday that it had been in talks with the Australian Stock Exchange for a second successive day about its share suspension but remained unsure when trading would resume.
"There is no timetable (for lifting the suspension) and I can't give you any indication when that will happen," Aristocrat general counsel Louise Sexton told Reuters.
The ASX suspended Aristocrat shares before the start of trading on Wednesday, seeking more information about the company's licensing dispute with the Colorado Gaming Control Commission.
Sexton also said that the Victoria Casino and Gaming Commission was examining the company. "Regulators always review the licences of companies," she said.
The Sydney Morning Herald said the Victorian authority was investigating the company but an authority spokesman told the paper it could not confirm this.
The paper also said market analysts believed Aristocrat shares could fall by up to 20 percent when trading resumed.
Its shares last traded at A$2.87 on Tuesday.
